description: Cued retrospective reporting (CRR) is a retrospective think-aloud protocol based on eye movements: subjects verbally report their thoughts after task completion, using their own previously recorded eye-tracking patterns as memory cues.
title: Cued retrospective reporting (CRR)

description: The article demonstrates a descriptive practice: representing grade outcomes as cumulative probability curves stratified by demographic group, so that differences at every grade threshold are visible rather than only mean grades.
title: Cumulative probability plotting of administrative grade data for demographic-group monitoring

description: Curricular analytics is the study of academic program design and layout, in which a degree plan is translated into a directed acyclic graph of courses and prerequisites.
title: Curricular analytics: graph-based measures of degree-program complexity (blocking, delay, centrality, structural complexity)

title: Curriculum analytics using cognitive diagnostic modeling and hierarchical learner-profile clustering

description: The article proposes an end-to-end framework in which a national curriculum textbook is ingested via OCR and semantic chunking, formalized against a predefined domain ontology, and used to construct a provenance-traced QA benchmark with category-level evaluation.
title: Curriculum-grounded ontology framework for building educational QA benchmarks

description: The article applies cumulative sum (CUSUM) methods as a quantitative framework for defining surgical proficiency.
title: CUSUM learning-curve analysis for procedural proficiency benchmarking
